# AC9 Cloth Sim Runtime

This is the calculation component supplied for use with **AC9 Cloth Sim**.
Install it through the main add-on's installation guide:
https://openfashion-labs.github.io/ac9_cloth_sim/extensions/preview/

It contains the unmodified Newton 1.6.0 and Warp 1.17.0 Python wheels.
Newton and the open-source portions of Warp retain their respective open-source
licenses. The included NVIDIA components remain subject to their accompanying
NVIDIA licenses; those components are not relicensed under the add-on's GPL.
The runtime package retains the applicable license texts and notices.

This release supplies an application dependency for AC9 Cloth Sim; it is not
offered as a general-purpose NVIDIA SDK distribution.
